shots.text: Truline sells through 500 partners. Even with 64 partner account managers, coverage is never enough: only 50 partners get a dedicated one, 250 share one, and 200 get nobody. We're changing that.

One governed engine on Snowflake, with Claude doing more as coverage thins. Noah covers 19 partners. The agent ranks 279 plays worth $24.3 million, routes each to the owner rep, escalates the big ones, and one click approves and logs them.
For Fatima's top partner, Claude writes the internal brief and the partner version. Every number cites the semantic view; internal facts never reach the partner.
Then it checks the news against our plays: growth says push, headwinds say pull back.
The 200 partners nobody covers get a monthly report, written by Claude and claim-checked.
Each persona is a real Snowflake user, so policies decide what they see.
A made-up 4.7 million? Blocked and logged.
Every number sourced, every action audited, every partner in reach.
